VALIDATION & KEY DIAGNOSTIC (scouting, outside the deliverable): the vectorized kernel was verified bit-exact against a naive scalar reference; the symmetric special case brackets the standard 1D contact-process per-neighbor threshold (~1.6–1.7, matching the classic λ_c=3.2978 total-rate convention), confirming kernel correctness. This is exactly why the deliverable reports a wide CI, dynamic_scale_observed=False, and conclusion="inconclusive" — the conservative outcome you asked for. All method choices, RNG child-stream protocol (SeedSequence(1802620927), size-major spawn order), the ρ_ss conditioning rule, and both estimators are documented in dp_report.json method_summary; assessment_note states the finite-budget limitation explicitly.
